correctness.rationale: The standard truncated-tetrahedral graph has twelve ordered-pair vertices (a,b), each degree three, 18 edges from four triangles and six reversal edges. Exhausting all 4096 vertex masks independently reproduced 864 augmented Ind_2 faces, f-vector (12,66,192,303,228,62), facets exactly three 3-faces plus 62 5-faces. Reconstructing the explicit toggle order gave 429 augmented pairs; the complete 3432 ordinary Hasse covers are acyclic by topological sorting of all 863 nonempty faces. The three critical 3-cells and three critical 4-cells have an exact signed 3x3 zero boundary. Their 3-sphere wedge is 2-connected, so pi3~H3 and the zero attaching degrees give 3 S3 + 3 S4 integrally. Nonpure shellability is obstructed by H4 nonzero in a nonfacet dimension; no all-polyhedra claim follows.
